Do I need to buy an activation code firs.en: Do I need to buy an activation code first?
Do I need to buy an activation code firs.ms: Perlukah saya membeli kod pengaktifan dahulu?

For a standard online subscription, acce.en: For a standard online subscription, access is activated automatically after confirmed payment. You do not need to buy, wait for or manually enter a separate activation code.
For a standard online subscription, acce.ms: Bagi langganan dalam talian biasa, akses diaktifkan secara automatik selepas pembayaran disahkan. Anda tidak perlu membeli, menunggu atau memasukkan kod pengaktifan berasingan secara manual.

The six-digit email code used during par.en: The six-digit email code used during parent registration only verifies your email. Enter it on the verification screen; never share it in chat.
The six-digit email code used during par.ms: Kod e-mel enam digit semasa pendaftaran ibu bapa hanya mengesahkan e-mel anda. Masukkannya pada skrin pengesahan; jangan kongsikan dalam chat.

I already have a parent account. Should.en: I already have a parent account. Should I register again?
I already have a parent account. Should.ms: Saya sudah mempunyai akaun ibu bapa. Perlukah saya mendaftar lagi?

No. <a href=\"/login\">Log in</a> with y.en: No. Log in with your existing parent email and password to subscribe for another child or renew an existing child.
No. <a href=\"/login\">Log in</a> with y.ms: Tidak. Log masuk menggunakan e-mel dan kata laluan ibu bapa sedia ada untuk melanggan bagi anak lain atau memperbaharui langganan anak.

How much does a subscription cost?.en: How much does a subscription cost?

The parent dashboard shows the current p.en: The parent dashboard shows the current price for each available 6- or 12-month option. Review the duration, price and total at checkout before completing payment. Each subscription is for one child account.
The parent dashboard shows the current p.ms: Dashboard ibu bapa memaparkan harga semasa bagi setiap pilihan 6 atau 12 bulan yang tersedia. Semak tempoh, harga dan jumlah semasa checkout sebelum membayar. Setiap langganan adalah untuk satu akaun anak.

Can I subscribe for more than one child?.en: Can I subscribe for more than one child?
Can I subscribe for more than one child?.ms: Bolehkah saya melanggan untuk lebih daripada seorang anak?

Yes. Choose a package and enter separate.en: Yes. Choose a package and enter separate details for each child. Add the child packages to the cart and complete one combined checkout. Each child receives their own account and subscription after payment is confirmed.
Yes. Choose a package and enter separate.ms: Ya. Pilih pakej dan masukkan maklumat berasingan bagi setiap anak. Tambahkan pakej anak ke troli dan lengkapkan satu pembayaran bersama. Setiap anak menerima akaun dan langganan sendiri selepas pembayaran disahkan.

How does my child start learning after p.en: How does my child start learning after payment?
How does my child start learning after p.ms: Bagaimanakah anak saya mula belajar selepas pembayaran?

After payment confirmation, check Childr.en: After payment confirmation, check Children in the parent dashboard. Your child can log in using the child username and password chosen at checkout. A receipt is also sent to the parent’s email.
After payment confirmation, check Childr.ms: Selepas pembayaran disahkan, semak Children dalam dashboard ibu bapa. Anak boleh log masuk menggunakan nama pengguna dan kata laluan anak yang dipilih semasa checkout. Resit juga dihantar ke e-mel ibu bapa.

How do I renew, and will my child keep t.en: How do I renew, and will my child keep the same account?
How do I renew, and will my child keep t.ms: Bagaimanakah saya memperbaharui langganan, dan adakah akaun anak kekal?

Log in as the parent, open Children and.en: Log in as the parent, open Children and choose Renew for the existing child. Select an available term and complete payment. The same child account and learning history remain; you do not need to create another account.
Log in as the parent, open Children and.ms: Log masuk sebagai ibu bapa, buka Children dan pilih Renew untuk anak sedia ada. Pilih tempoh yang tersedia dan lengkapkan pembayaran. Akaun serta sejarah pembelajaran anak kekal; anda tidak perlu mencipta akaun lain.

Is this a monthly or automatically renew.en: Is this a monthly or automatically renewing subscription?
Is this a monthly or automatically renew.ms: Adakah ini langganan bulanan atau diperbaharui secara automatik?

The current checkout offers a selected 6.en: The current checkout offers a selected 6- or 12-month term paid at checkout. It is not monthly instalment billing. Renew the existing child through the parent dashboard when needed; the current flow does not automatically charge for renewal.
The current checkout offers a selected 6.ms: Checkout semasa menawarkan tempoh pilihan 6 atau 12 bulan yang dibayar semasa checkout. Ia bukan bil ansuran bulanan. Perbaharui langganan anak melalui dashboard ibu bapa apabila diperlukan; aliran semasa tidak mengenakan caj pembaharuan secara automatik.

Learning is organised by school level, s.en: Learning is organised by school level, subject and topic. Resources include interactive objective practice and written-answer activities where available. Check the selected package for its subjects, videos, notes and other learning resources.
Learning is organised by school level, s.ms: Pembelajaran disusun mengikut tahap persekolahan, subjek dan topik. Sumber termasuk latihan objektif interaktif dan aktiviti jawapan bertulis yang tersedia. Semak pakej pilihan untuk subjek, video, nota dan sumber pembelajarannya.

Does my child need to follow a fixed stu.en: Does my child need to follow a fixed study timetable?
Does my child need to follow a fixed stu.ms: Adakah anak saya perlu mengikut jadual belajar tetap?

Self-paced practice and educational game.en: Self-paced practice and educational games can be used while the subscription is active. Online classes follow their own announced schedule. Class availability, recordings and supporting materials depend on the selected package and current programme.
Self-paced practice and educational game.ms: Latihan kendiri dan permainan pendidikan boleh digunakan semasa langganan aktif. Kelas dalam talian mengikut jadual yang diumumkan. Ketersediaan kelas, rakaman dan bahan sokongan bergantung pada pakej pilihan dan program semasa.

HomeTutor Play offers educational games.en: HomeTutor Play offers educational games that help students practise through challenges and interactive activities. Children access it through their HomeTutor learning account.
HomeTutor Play offers educational games.ms: HomeTutor Play menawarkan permainan pendidikan yang membantu pelajar berlatih melalui cabaran dan aktiviti interaktif. Anak mengaksesnya melalui akaun pembelajaran HomeTutor.

Can I track my child’s learning progress.en: Can I track my child’s learning progress?
Can I track my child’s learning progress.ms: Bolehkah saya memantau kemajuan pembelajaran anak?

Yes. The parent dashboard shows linked c.en: Yes. The parent dashboard shows linked child accounts, learning activity, progress and reports. Use this information to see what your child has practised and where they may need more support.
Yes. The parent dashboard shows linked c.ms: Ya. Dashboard ibu bapa memaparkan akaun anak yang dipautkan, aktiviti pembelajaran, kemajuan dan laporan. Gunakan maklumat ini untuk melihat latihan yang telah dibuat dan bahagian yang memerlukan lebih sokongan.

HomeTutor can be used through a web brow.en: HomeTutor can be used through a web browser on a computer, tablet or smartphone. A stable internet connection and a current browser help with classes, games and learning resources.
HomeTutor can be used through a web brow.ms: HomeTutor boleh digunakan melalui pelayar web pada komputer, tablet atau telefon pintar. Sambungan internet yang stabil dan pelayar terkini membantu penggunaan kelas, permainan dan sumber pembelajaran.

My email verification code has not arriv.en: My email verification code has not arrived. What should I do?
My email verification code has not arriv.ms: Kod pengesahan e-mel saya belum diterima. Apakah yang perlu dibuat?

Check Inbox and Spam/Junk, confirm the e.en: Check Inbox and Spam/Junk, confirm the email address you entered and use Resend when the verification screen allows it. Use the latest six-digit code on that screen. Never share it in chat.
Check Inbox and Spam/Junk, confirm the e.ms: Semak Inbox dan Spam/Junk, pastikan alamat e-mel yang dimasukkan betul dan gunakan Resend apabila skrin pengesahan membenarkannya. Gunakan kod enam digit terkini pada skrin tersebut. Jangan kongsikannya dalam chat.

My payment is pending or access has not.en: My payment is pending or access has not appeared. What should I do?
My payment is pending or access has not.ms: Pembayaran saya masih pending atau akses belum muncul. Apakah yang perlu dibuat?

Check Payment Log and Children in the pa.en: Check Payment Log and Children in the parent dashboard. Subscription access starts after payment confirmation, rather than just after submitting checkout.
Check Payment Log and Children in the pa.ms: Semak Payment Log dan Children dalam dashboard ibu bapa. Akses langganan bermula selepas pengesahan pembayaran, bukan sekadar selepas menghantar checkout.

If money was deducted but the payment is.en: If money was deducted but the payment is not confirmed, email help@hometutor.com.my with the registered parent email, order or payment reference, and a redacted screenshot. Check the status before paying again.
If money was deducted but the payment is.ms: Jika wang telah ditolak tetapi pembayaran belum disahkan, e-mel help@hometutor.com.my bersama e-mel ibu bapa berdaftar, rujukan pesanan atau pembayaran dan tangkap layar yang disunting. Semak status sebelum membayar lagi.

I cannot log in. How can I recover acces.en: I cannot log in. How can I recover access?
I cannot log in. How can I recover acces.ms: Saya tidak boleh log masuk. Bagaimanakah saya mendapatkan semula akses?

Parents use their own email and password.en: Parents use their own email and password; children use the child username and password chosen at checkout. Check that you are using the correct account. Use password recovery if needed.
Parents use their own email and password.ms: Ibu bapa menggunakan e-mel dan kata laluan sendiri; anak menggunakan nama pengguna dan kata laluan yang dipilih semasa checkout. Pastikan akaun yang digunakan betul. Gunakan pemulihan kata laluan jika diperlukan.

What if a lesson, practice activity or g.en: What if a lesson, practice activity or game will not load?
What if a lesson, practice activity or g.ms: Bagaimana jika kelas, latihan atau permainan tidak dapat dimuatkan?

Check your connection, refresh the page.en: Check your connection, refresh the page and try another current browser or device. Confirm that the correct child account is signed in and its subscription is active. If the issue remains, send support a short description and a screenshot.
Check your connection, refresh the page.ms: Semak sambungan, muat semula halaman dan cuba pelayar terkini atau peranti lain. Pastikan akaun anak yang betul telah log masuk dan langganannya aktif. Jika masalah berterusan, hantarkan penerangan ringkas dan tangkap layar kepada sokongan.

How do I contact HomeTutor support?.en: How do I contact HomeTutor support?

Use HT Bot for general product and subsc.en: Use HT Bot for general product and subscription questions. For account-specific issues, email help@hometutor.com.my with your registered parent email and a short description. Include an order reference for payment issues. Do not send passwords, verification codes or full payment-card details.
Use HT Bot for general product and subsc.ms: Gunakan HT Bot untuk soalan umum tentang produk dan langganan. Bagi masalah akaun khusus, e-mel help@hometutor.com.my bersama e-mel ibu bapa berdaftar dan penerangan ringkas. Sertakan rujukan pesanan bagi isu pembayaran. Jangan hantar kata laluan, kod pengesahan atau maklumat penuh kad pembayaran.

This policy applies to HomeTutor subscri.en: This policy applies to HomeTutor subscription purchases made online or offline.
This policy applies to HomeTutor subscri.ms: Polisi ini terpakai kepada pembelian langganan HomeTutor secara dalam talian atau luar talian.

Hi! 👋 I'm HT Bot, your HomeTutor assista.en: Hi! 👋 I'm HT Bot, your HomeTutor assistant. Ask me about learning, registration, subscriptions or account access. How can I help?
Hi! 👋 I'm HT Bot, your HomeTutor assista.ms: Hi! 👋 Saya HT Bot, pembantu HomeTutor anda. Tanya saya tentang pembelajaran, pendaftaran, langganan atau akses akaun. Bagaimanakah saya boleh membantu?

Live online classes with expert tutors,.en: Live online classes with expert tutors, structured learning content, intensive practice, smart AI tutoring, and progress reports to help your child excel.
Live online classes with expert tutors,.ms: Kelas langsung dalam talian bersama tutor pakar, kandungan pembelajaran berstruktur, latihan intensif, bimbingan AI pintar dan laporan kemajuan untuk membantu anak anda cemerlang.
